title: Kanban board
summary: A team board with fixed cards: drag and drop within and across columns with placeholders and animation, a detail panel, filters, search, undo, dark mode, and one-column-at-a-time scrolling on a phone.
watchFor: Drag feel: does the card follow, does a placeholder show, do others move aside?
Does Undo really revert the last move?
Overdue flags, counts and filters staying consistent
interaction: Drag two cards across columns, undo, filter Bug, open a card, close it, switch to dark mode; on the phone, swipe through the columns and open a card.
